environment: managed Linux desktop browser; exact user agent and outer viewport recorded on every start
seed: natural Math.random; unknown and uncontrolled; no selection or injection; not paired random trials
controller: rendered canvas pixels + visible HUD only

policyChange.exactDiff: hard hazard OR includes nominal observed radius at the existing lethal threshold; diagnostics and naming do not change decisions
policyChange.rationale: the old interval fraction can classify an already nominally lethal body as soft, particularly near the v2.22 size cap
policyChange.unchanged: geometry, fallback radii, red marker bounds, target value, scouts, immunity, motion prediction, path horizon, weights and tracking
policyChange.hypothesis: hard avoidance may reduce early deaths; additional avoidance may reduce growth and increase cutoffs; no causal efficacy claim before the new batch

instrumentationChange: additional numeric selected-target coordinates/motion/stall/blocked fields and local hard/soft/promoted counts; startup page/harness/planner SHA-256 verification; independent 100ms visible-stop watchdog; save abort after2500ms with unconfirmed records displayed for reconciliation; win without visible result time is unknown; no pixels or hidden state

perception.minimap: strict growMarkers for candidate; no permissive white fallback
perception.plannerLogic: Grow15 with nominal-lethal hard hazard condition; all other strategy choices unchanged
perception.geometry: frozen geometry.js; accepted pixel centre AND radius converted by capture ratio; null preserves original; NPCs only

confirmation.condition: both versions have exactly four native screen finals and >=2 wins each; frozen same candidate; 12 new starts per version; no data pooling

success.evidence: this run visible You win settlement and visible result Play time <=02:30; HUD may stop updating during ending animation

stop.gameDeadline: visible HUD elapsed >150 (integer display, normally151); settlement checked first
stop.manual: stop batch records controller_abort and releases all held keys
stop.persistenceFailure: stop and retain infrastructure_error or unconfirmed visible records; reconcile by runId before sidecar, no replacements; unconfirmed final never triggers a second final; server rejects duplicate start/final identities

denominatorPolicy: every start stays in its version and phase denominator; death, cutoff, late win, infrastructure error, abort and unknown are separately reported; no replacements, exclusions or restarting an interrupted batch
acceptance: research only: both confirmation versions require >=6/12 observed wins for this sample target; report Wilson 95% intervals; no formal OCR4 release, all-version acceptance or long-term guarantee
unsupportedClaims: synthetic fixtures are not game outcomes
historical uncontrolled batches do not establish causal improvement
v2.20/v2.21 not tested in this user-requested two-version batch
freezePolicy: no controller, game, harness or protocol edits after first start; new code requires a new candidate and batch identity
